content_zh:
“呼哧，呼哧，呼哧！”
楚云凡不断的喘着粗气，仅仅只是一瞬间而已，他居然感觉好像是过去了一辈子一样，再度清醒过来，恍如隔世。
那梦中的一幕幕，几乎就像是亲身经历一般，从刚开始学习炼丹时候的忐忑，到后来成为远近闻名的丹道大师时候的意气风发，再到成就丹皇时候的辉煌，一直到最后的陨落，每一幕，都异常清晰。
就像他真的在久远年代以前，亲眼见证过这样一场旷世大战一样。
那是诸神的黄昏，一个个盖代的强者像是落饺子一样的陨落在了那里。
楚云凡也不知道现如今人类中最强的高手有多强，毕竟他的层次还太低了，但是他本能的觉得，只怕远不如他梦里的那些神魔一样的强者要强大。
现如今人类的顶尖高手号称连核弹都炸不死，放在公历时代简直不敢想象，但是也没有听说谁能够翻江倒海，捉星拿月。
“那应该是，超古代？”楚云凡回想梦中的场景，那些人所使用的文字，确实就是古篆字没错。
只是不知道什么原因，这一场辉煌之极的旷世之战和丹皇的经历以及丹皇的记忆居然通过那一幅山河图保留了下来，现在一下子全部涌入了他的脑海之中。
他已经想明白了，这绝对不是梦，哪有梦这么清楚的，甚至许多强者的强大，是他想都想不到的，虽然他从未经历过，但是不代表他不明白，超古代文明本身就隐藏了很多很多的秘密不曾解开。
一直以来，在史学界就有一种猜测，那就是超古代一定是一个武道昌盛的武学盛世，从陆续挖掘到的诸多与武道相关的东西就可以看得出来。
但是他们一定想不到，那是一个何等精彩的世界，在进入昆仑历之后，武道复兴就开始了，但是说到底也不过只有数百年的时间。
而按照现如今所挖掘到的超古代文明的资料来看，超古代文明已经强盛了很多万年了。
不过他心中也有疑惑，强盛之极的超古代文明为什么会销声匿迹了？
这也正是史学界的未解之谜，从挖掘到的种种资料来看，超古代文明并不是慢慢衰败下去的，而是一夜之间消失的。
这其中又有什么秘密呢？
难道是和他记忆中的那一场旷世之战有关系么？
楚云凡只是感觉好像身体里多了什么，所以现在感觉自己的思维好像前所未有的清晰，目光所及之处也是前所未有的明媚，好似天地间的一切都鲜艳了起来，隐隐都不一样了。
这种感觉是如此的明显，哪怕不用特意去感觉，也感觉得到身体之中的变化，好似感觉全身上下，都充满着能量。
“嘿，想什么呢？”高宏志的声音传来，“从刚才你就站着，该不会是看入迷了吧，赶紧的，回家了！”

高宏志的声音将楚云凡的从那个梦幻一般的盛世之中拉了回来，转眼看了一下周围，学生们都在渐渐散去，夕阳西下，将人的影子拉的很长。
“没事！”楚云凡摇摇头，最终还是决定将刚才的那一梦埋藏在心底，谁也不能说。
“怎么感觉你好像不一样了？”高宏志看了一眼楚云凡说道，隐隐然觉得自己的这个好友好似变的不一样了，但是哪儿变的不一样了，又说不出来，只是感觉好像整个人都不一样了，有一种脱胎换骨的感觉。
“是不是又变帅了？哎，没办法，人本来就这么帅！”楚云凡嘿嘿一笑说道。
“滚，我真的发现，你越来越不要脸了！”高宏志皱着眉头说道，刚才的那一丝异样的感觉也消失于无形了。
“行了，少废话了，回去吧！”楚云凡道，他能够感觉到身体的不同，他已经迫不及待，想要回家去好好检测一下到底什么情况了。
与以往一样，出了校门之后，高宏志被一辆飞行车接走了，在昆仑历时代车辆都已经改用能量块了，不再烧汽油了，一点污染都没有，而且由于反重力系统的广泛运用，都不再会在地上跑，而是直接飞行，比起公历时代的汽车不知道要高级多少。
而楚云凡则是要步行一段时间去乘坐公交车，在公历时代，由于汽车的普及，当时拥有汽车的人非常多，但是在昆仑历时代，汽车都已经升级换代，变成飞行车，那价格也跟着蹭蹭的往上涨，一般人也买不起，所以公共交通也变的前所未有的发达。

content_en:
"Whoop, whoop, whoop!"
Chu Yunfan kept breathing heavily, but for just a moment, he actually felt as if a lifetime had passed, and when he woke up again, it was like a lifetime ago.
The scenes in the dream were almost like personal experiences. From the anxiety when he first started learning alchemy, to the high spirits when he became a famous alchemy master, to the glory when he became the Alchemy King, to the final fall, every scene was extremely clear.
It was as if he had witnessed such a great battle a long time ago.
It was the twilight of the gods, and all the powerful men fell there like dumplings.
Chu Yunfan didn't know how strong the strongest master among humans was now. After all, his level was still too low, but he instinctively felt that he was far less powerful than the powerful gods and demons in his dreams.
Nowadays, the top masters of mankind claim that they cannot even be killed by nuclear bombs. This was unimaginable in the Gregorian calendar era, but I have never heard of anyone who can conquer the rivers and seas and catch the stars and the moon.
"That should be, super ancient?" Chu Yunfan recalled the scene in his dream. The characters used by those people were indeed ancient seal characters.
But for some unknown reason, this glorious battle, the Dan Emperor’s experience, and the Dan Emperor’s memory were actually preserved through that picture of mountains and rivers, and now they all poured into his mind.
He has already figured it out. This is definitely not a dream. How can any dream be so clear? Even many powerful people are so powerful that he has never imagined. Although he has never experienced it, it does not mean that he does not understand that the super-ancient civilization itself hides many secrets that have not yet been solved.
There has always been a speculation in the field of history that the ultra-ancient times must have been a prosperous martial arts age, which can be seen from the many things related to martial arts that have been excavated one after another.
But they must have never imagined what a wonderful world it was. After entering the Kunlun calendar, the martial arts revival began, but in the end it only lasted a few hundred years.
According to the data on super-ancient civilization that has been excavated today, super-ancient civilization has been strong for many thousands of years.
But he also had doubts in his heart, why did the extremely powerful super-ancient civilization disappear?
This is also an unsolved mystery in the field of history. Judging from various data excavated, super-ancient civilization did not slowly decline, but disappeared overnight.
What's the secret in this?
Could it be related to the great battle in his memory?
Chu Yunfan just felt as if there was something extra in his body, so now he felt that his thinking seemed clearer than ever before, and everything he looked at was brighter than ever before. It seemed that everything in the world became brighter and faintly different.
This feeling is so obvious that even if you don't feel it specifically, you can still feel the changes in your body, as if your whole body is full of energy.
"Hey, what are you thinking about?" Gao Hongzhi's voice came, "You have been standing here since just now. You must have been fascinated by it. Hurry up and go home!"
Gao Hongzhi's voice pulled Chu Yunfan back from that dreamlike prosperous world. He looked around in a blink of an eye. The students were gradually dispersing. The setting sun stretched people's shadows very long.
"It's okay!" Chu Yunfan shook his head, and finally decided to bury the dream just now in his heart, and no one could say anything about it.
"Why do you feel like you are different?" Gao Hongzhi glanced at Chu Yunfan and said. He vaguely felt that his good friend seemed to be different, but he couldn't tell where it was different. He just felt that his whole person was different, and he felt like he had been reborn.
"Have you become handsome again? Hey, I can't help it, people are so handsome to begin with!"Chu Yunfan said with a smile.
"Go away, I really find that you are becoming more and more shameless!" Gao Hongzhi said with a frown, and the strange feeling just now disappeared.
"Okay, stop talking nonsense and go back!" Chu Yunfan said. He could feel the difference in his body. He couldn't wait to go home and check what was going on.
As before, after leaving school, Gao Hongzhi was picked up by a flying car. In the Kunlun Calendar Era, vehicles had switched to using energy blocks, no longer burning gasoline, and there was no pollution at all. Moreover, due to the widespread use of anti-gravity systems, they no longer ran on the ground, but flew directly. I don't know how much more advanced than the cars in the Gregorian Calendar Era.
Chu Yunfan had to walk for a while to take the bus. In the Gregorian calendar era, due to the popularity of cars, many people owned cars at that time. However, in the Kunlun calendar era, cars have been upgraded and turned into flying cars. The prices have also been rising, and ordinary people cannot afford them. Therefore, public transportation has become more developed than ever.
